changelog:
Seven settings navigation layouts: top tabs, bottom tabs, left sidebar, area selector, right sidebar, previous/next area and all areas in one list.
Choose the layout directly in CSM Appearance settings; adaptive sidebars, large text and TV D-pad navigation remain supported.
Removed the Watch & download, Make it yours, Connect & share and App & safety headings. All settings destinations remain directly accessible.
Preserved native preference storage, cross-area search, prerequisite summaries and selected-area restoration.
message: Dev build v851 - Seven navigation layouts and direct settings
